notes.title: Rysen: v1.0.7 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game engine runtime has been updated to the latest version.
[*] Minor fixed the speed-display when shifting fighter's speed.
[/list]

If there are bugs, please report those.

notes.title: Rysen: v1.0.4 update
notes.content:
Added support to the screenshot function of Steam Overlay.
Please note that the key to take screenshots depends on the setting of Steam.
Also note that the image size differs between windowed mode & fullscreen mode.
Note: This function is not added to the demo version.

tags.feature: Added support to the screenshot function of Steam Overlay.

notes.title: Rysen: v1.0.2 update / Rysen Demo: v1.0.2 update
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]In-game options: Added the function to blink when the enemies are damaged. This setting can be switched ON/OFF with F11 during game. Set it to OFF to make it the same condition as the older version.
    [*]In-game options: For the above change, move the reset key assigned from F11 to F12.
[/list]
Warning: If you are not good at flashing, please turn off this setting.
